Naval Diving and Salvage Training Center (NDSTC) has a reoccurring requirement for the delivery of bulk medical grade Helium (HE), Carbon Dioxide (CO2) and the rental of two (2) 2,000-liter CO2 micro-bulk storage tanks. Delivery of these gases support the dive training and evaluation of more than 1,200 joint service students annually. 2.0 DESCRIPTON OF SUPPLIES OR SERVICES 2.1 Helium (HE) The vendor will deliver to NDSTC approximately 45,000 standard cubic feet of bulk HE in the first quarter of the fiscal year, and possibly a second delivery of the same quantity in the last half of th

sla_onsite.text: sibly a second delivery of the same quantity in the last half of the year. The vendor will transfer the HE into Government owned storage tanks. HE will meet the following US Navy Divers Compressed Helium Breathing Purity Requirements (Military Specification MIL-PRF- 27407): - Helium (percent by volume) 99.997% - Moisture (water vapor) 9 ppm (max) - Dew Point (not greater than) -78F - Hydrocarbons (as Methane) 1 ppm (max) - Oxygen 3 ppm (max) - Nitrogen + Argon 5 ppm (max) - Neon 23 ppm (max) - Hydrogen 1 ppm (max) 2.2 Carbon Dioxide (CO2) The vendor will provide two (2) onsite CO2 storage micro-bulk storage tanks; one supporting a 300,000-gallon pool (PERMA CYL 1000) and one supporting a 1,000,000-gallon pool (PERMA CYL 2000). This rental will include general maintenance, urgent repairs, and notification of tank levels and warnings via the Telemetry Unit. The Telemetry unit is a proprietary unit that will monitor the levels of the CO2 and communicate directly with the vendor when the levels become low. The vendor will provide CO2 as required. Anticipated delivery schedule requirement is 2-3 times per month with a total annual requirement of approximately 68,000 lbs. N6883626Q0048 Page 5 of 31 3.0 DELIVERY

This procurement is a total set-aside for Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). Prospective offerors must be registered and current in the System for Award Management (SAM) database at time of offer to the Government (https://www.sam.gov). A list of the contract line items, quantities, and units of measure are listed within the attached solicitation documentation. The VA anticipates one firm fixed price IDIQ contract award to provide services to the Nebraska-Western Iowa VA Healthcare System. The anticipated period of performance is 08-17-2026 to 08-16-2031 for the ordering life of the IDIQ contract. FAR provisions 52.212-1, 52.212-2, and 52.212-3 apply to this procurement and are detailed within the attached solicitation document. FAR clauses 52.212-4 and 52.212-5 apply to this procurement and are included within the attached solicitation document. Additional requirements are listed within the attached solicitation document. The Defense Priorities and Allocations System (DPAS) does not apply to this acquisition. Technical questions on this solicitation are due via e-mail only to Jesse Sweesy, Contracting Officer, at jesse.sweesy@va.gov no later than 10:00am Central Standard Time (CST), 08-07-2026. Quotes are due to the Contracting Office by 10:00am CST, 08-10-2026. Quotes are required to be emailed to jesse.sweesy@va.gov prior to the solicitation closing date and time. Nõuded pakkumusele 1.3.1. Pakkumus tuleb esitada RHR-i kaudu. 1.3.2. Pakkumuses esitatud maksumused peavad olema esitatud eurodes (EUR). Energex OÜ hankedokument 5 1.3.3. Pakkumuse kogumaksumus esitatakse ühe summana, mis hõlmab endas kõiki paigaldamiseks vajalikke materjalikulusid, projekteerimisega seotud töid ja teenuseid, tootmiskulusid, kulusid hankele ja alltöövõtule (kui neid esineb), tarnet, paigaldust (kui see on nõutud) ja täies mahus tööde täislahenduse pakkumust, mis peavad olema kvaliteetsed ja vastama HD -s nõutud tingimustele ning mis teostatakse heale tavale tuginedes. Kõik tingimused, mis on kirjas HD- s ning mis on seotud Pakkuja vastutusega seadmete kasutuselevõtmisel, peavad olema täidetud. Hankija võib küsida ka detailset eelarvet. 1.3.4. Alternatiivseid lahendusi ei ole lubatud pakkuda. 1.3.5. Pakkumuse maksumus esitatakse Eestis kehtiva käibemaksuta. Kõik ülejäänud maksud, tollid (sealhulgas impordi - ja tollimaksud), litsentside tasud, sertifikaadid, tööload ja muud tasud, mis tasutakse Eestis või mujal, peavad sisalduma pakkumuse maksumuses. 1.3.6. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. Please note: Before you can use the postbox you must record your interest in a notice.
